title: Ek Deewane Ki Deewaniyat
overview: When Vikramaditya, a powerful politician falls  for a strong-willed superstar Adaa , their passionate romance quickly spirals into a dangerous game of obsession and pride. As emotions clash and tempers rise, Adaa makes a life-altering choice.
